description: Connect this agent to the user's SEAL inbox, once. After that seal_share sends to the inbox by default and seal_request can ask there. The user compares three words on the page with the ones you show.

name.description: How the inbox names this agent; default the MCP client's name.

wait.description: Wait until the user connects. Where your client cannot show links itself, the link comes back first: show it and the three words, then call again with wait:true.

name: seal_pair
title: Connect to the user's inbox
